report:
Soft tissue, right inguinal hernia sac, excision

Received in formalin is a membranous sac labelled right inguinal hernia sac, measuring 4 x 3 x 0.5 cm. Representative sections in 1 block.

(1) Hernia sac, representative sections.

Sections show peritoneal fibroadipose tissue lined by benign mesothelium. No vas deferens or epididymal tissue is identified. Features are in keeping with a hernia sac. There is no evidence of granulomatous inflammation or malignancy.

SOFT TISSUE, right inguinal hernia sac, excision - In keeping with HERNIA SAC
